extraFacts.fact: Thorburn model codes in the exotic-alloy and stainless listings: 95 is an unbraided core, 96 a single braid and 96Z a double braid in the same alloy.

extraFacts.fact: Corrugated metal hose terms: annular corrugation is a series of parallel rings (versus helical, a continuous spiral); braid is a woven wire sleeve that contains pressure; ISO 10380 covers corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies, with a safety factor of 4:1 on burst pressure as quoted in the listings; hoses are hydrotested at 1.5 times working pressure.
extraFacts.source: ISO 10380 (corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies); manufacturer listings

faqs.q: What is the Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling used for?
faqs.a: The Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling — Lightweight is a specialty quick-coupling designed for the metallic-hose service envelope. Typical uses include tanker truck top-loading depots, fuel terminal loading racks and bulk-chemical truck loading. See the [metallic hose couplings](/c/metallic-hose-couplings).

faqs.q: What sizes does the Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling come in?
faqs.a: The Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling is listed with a bore range of DN 50 (2") to DN 100 (4"). Confirm the size and length on your request.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature can the Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling take?
faqs.a: The Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling has a working pressure of 16 bar (64 bar burst); a temperature range of -40°C to +150°C. Hydrotested at 1.5× working pressure. Per ASME B31.3. Designed for repeated connect / disconnect cycles in industrial service.

faqs.q: What is the Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling made of?
faqs.a: The Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling has body material Carbon steel A105 and end fitting Carbon steel SA105 body, 316SS external sleeve, HNBR backup seals. Construction type: specialty Coupling — Lightweight metal-to-metal seal tanker coupling (carbon steel).

faqs.q: Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling: how is connect / disconnect performed?
faqs.a: See OEM commissioning manual for specific connect / disconnect procedure. Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: can the Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling be used in sour-service (H₂S) installations?
faqs.a: Body material is standard service. For sour-service, specify the NACE MR0175 compliant variant (typically 316L SS or Monel 400 body) on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What do I send to order the Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling?
faqs.a: To order the Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling, confirm (a) end-connection size and style on each side, (b) operating pressure / temperature envelope, (c) any required certifications. (d) seal material preference (NBR / FKM / FFKM / PEEK / Teflon — drives chemical compatibility and temperature limit). Indus matches the coupling halves to your hose assemblies and supplies the matched gaskets and fasteners.

faqs.q: what standards / certifications does the Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling meet?
faqs.a: ASME B31.3. EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2 mill test reports for body material on request. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling: what body and seal materials are used?
faqs.a: Body: Carbon steel A105. End fitting: Carbon steel SA105 body, 316SS external sleeve, HNBR backup seals. Standard seals: NBR (general service), FKM / Viton (chemical / hydrocarbon), PEEK (cryogenic), Teflon (chemical inertness). Seal selection is driven by the process medium and temperature envelope.

faqs.q: Where is the Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling typically used?
faqs.a: The Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling has several listed uses. Listed uses: tanker truck top-loading depots; fuel terminal loading racks; bulk-chemical truck loading; asphalt / heavy-fuel truck loading.

faqs.q: How does the Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling compare with the Thorburn MTS4 Met-O-Seal Tanker Coupling?
faqs.a: The Thorburn MT3TL Met-O-Seal Tanker Truck Loading Coupling differs from the [Thorburn MTS4 Met-O-Seal Tanker Coupling](/p/thorburn-mts4-met-o-seal-tanker-coupling-heavy-duty) on pressure and construction.
